scope: Source-only point producer/consumer, bitmap and slist collision review
method: Read exact frozen sources and inspect reachable state/control paths; no simulator, synthesis, PNR, SAT or CPU run.

vendor_contract.rule: Cross-port simultaneous read/write to the same physical address is prohibited; equality is on input AD[13:4]. SDP supports Normal write mode. 138K does not support read-before-write.
vendor_contract.consequence: RTL nonblocking old-data semantics and prior vendor-model tests do not establish electrical collision behavior.

bitmap.rtl_nonoverlap: proved by static state/pipeline inspection after valid reset; no we and re overlap at all
bitmap.reads: Only current phase C or D (trav_v3:359).
bitmap.writes: Only delayed phase A or B tokens (trav_v3:530-545).
drain_proof: Let e0 be the final B scan edge, which enters FLUSH with counter16.
That final token reaches v1@e0, wval@e1, s2@e2, s3@e3, s4@e4, s5@e5, s6@e6, s7@e7, s8@e8, bm_we@e9; RAM samples its write at e10.
FLUSH consumes old counter16 through0 at e1..e17; phase C begins after e17, and the first C RAM read samples at e18.
Thus even the latest B write precedes first C read by8 clocks. A/B do not request bitmap reads; C/D never generate bitmap writes. Reset clears all valid tokens and write enable.
bitmap.physical_pending: Verify actual mapped read CEB/BLKSEL is disabled when RTL re=0. OCE-only output hold with CEB always active is insufficient.
bitmap.minimum_change: No new consumer cycle or lifecycle change required if physical read enable respects re; qualify actual primitive at stage3.

slist.rtl_nonoverlap: proved by mutually exclusive assignments in one state case after valid reset
slist.writes: Only S_U3 sets registered sl_we; default0 each edge.
slist.reads: Only S_UC0 sets registered sl_re; default0 each edge. These are mutually exclusive case arms.
nearest_transition: e0 state U3 sets sl_we1 and moves to T0.
e1 RAM writes; T0 can enter UC0 when all sampled points finished.
e2 UC0 sets sl_re1; RAM has no slist operation.
e3 RAM reads while state UC1. Later UC2 clears touch bitmap, not slist.
slist.physical_pending: Same actual CEB/BLKSEL qualification as bitmap; no inferred-port assumption.
slist.minimum_change: Keep existing latency/state order; require effective physical read enable in mapped review.

point_buffer.capacity: 4096x36; candidate4 banks x(low18+high18), each1024 deep. No truncation or added read stage in candidate.
ungated_paths: Every accepted SOF resets producer n_pts to0 and base_x/base_y even while EVAL/UPDATE runs (extract:104-106; match:365).
IDLE accepts EVAL/UPDATE without testing pts_ready, ex_busy or pending pb_we (match:379-390).
busy is a status OR, not admission control; mt_frame_en contains only enable and valid height band (top:385).
concrete_RTL_reachable_collision: Complete one extraction with exactly one retained point. Start EVAL with multiple candidates while in IDLE; nsnap=1.
Each candidate visits S_T0 with j0, causing reads of address0. Start a new accepted extraction SOF during this EVAL; no RTL check blocks it.
Choose the legal new input-point timing/vertical-edge data so the first emitted point produces registered pb_we1,pb_wa0 on an edge immediately before one of those repeated pb_re1,pb_ra0 samples.
The next common RAM edge has both enables and the same logical/bank address0, therefore the same physical row for any faithful point mapping. No CDC, X, invalid address or point truncation is needed.
point_buffer.witness_limit: A legal RTL interface/state witness, not an executed simulator trace or proof this exact timing is generated by the frozen Pico FW.
normal_firmware_serialization: WAIT_POSE is enabled; MATCH_ONLY retains the original raw frame (hal:113-123; top:206-207; xt_frame_rx:410-427).
nav_app only commits a new first pass when both pm_pend and pm_run are false (app:174-175); pm_pend waits for ready, pm_run waits for EVAL_DONE.
UPDATE polls busy before finish_fusion releases the retained frame; FUSE_ONLY replay is excluded from slf_match s_fire (app:234-235,274-280; hal:222-233; top:388).
firmware_contract_not_general_proof: Readiness is sticky across SOF. Normal valid-band frames while receiving a map or in prior LOC_ODOM can still extract even though matching=false, leaving pts_ready1 without UPDATE. A later matching frame can therefore observe readiness from an earlier frame. This proves a missing generation contract; physical collision under that exact frozen CPU timing is not established here.
HAL start checks only enable and candidate count; no busy/current-frame check. UPDATE and wait-idle functions return void at a finite timeout, so timeout success is not checked by callers.
These gaps prevent treating FW conventions as an unconditional hardware mutual-exclusion invariant. They do not by themselves prove a collision in ordinary matched-frame execution.

update_timeout_audit.assumptions: Accepted online UPDATE, N256/PB4096, valid reset state, uninterrupted50MHz control clock, no asynchronous register-mode/reset changes.
update_timeout_audit.conclusion: The5ms timeout is not an established reachable timeout for the fixed ordinary accepted UPDATE. Do not cite it as a demonstrated collision mechanism.

minimum_robust_avoidance: Serialize ownership at existing raw-frame WAIT_POSE/start boundary: keep a full accepted frame waiting while the previous point generation is owned by EVAL/UPDATE; defer/ack or hold a pending commit rather than dropping its one-cycle pulse.

Accept or queue EVAL/UPDATE only for the completed current point generation, after extraction including its final registered pb_we has drained. Clear/replace ready on accepted new SOF and release ownership only after all point-dependent work is finished.

Preserve the existing one-cycle enabled point-RAM read and all4096 points. Add control/handshake state, not another point RAM. Exact FF/config-pending cost needs implementation; no new BSRAM is inherently required because raw-frame waiting already exists.

A simple frame_en &= !busy can silently discard a frame; gating only RAM reads/writes can corrupt output or truncate points. Address equality/bypass alone also fails to preserve old-data semantics or frame/base coherence. Do not use these as lifecycle fixes.

If firmware-only admission is chosen, make current-generation readiness and successful idle/release explicit, cover map-upload/mode/pose transitions, and retain raw-frame backpressure on timeout. This is a new verified contract, not already proved by the old tests.

acceptance_pending: Actual stage3 SDP primitive geometry, AD collision rows, CEA/CEB/BLKSEL and OCE semantics for all migrated stores.
